**About‑Us (Faded Archive)**  
Faded Archive is a made‑to‑order tee shop proudly based in Manchester. We craft unique prints for enthusiasts who value individuality and sustainable fashion. Each design is printed on high‑quality, fast‑dry cotton, then shipped directly from our local studio. Whether you’re looking for vintage‑inspired art or contemporary graphics, every shirt is made to your specifications—no stock, no waste. Join the archive that keeps the past alive, one custom tee at a time.

**Logo colour**  
Just keep it in a warm, earthy hue—deep forest green. It looks great on cotton and reflects Manchester’s industrial heritage.
